subject: ChatGPT Work Agent login access 🔐, Claude Opus 5 FPS game 🎮, Nvidia mo
intro: The GPT architecture is eating everything. OpenAI just let its Work agent log into password-protected sites, and Nvidia applied the same next-token trick to physical movement, hitting 99.98% accuracy on human motion. One predicts your next word. The other predicts your next cartwheel. Same idea, wildly different outputs. The foundation model playbook is now the default answer to almost every hard problem. We're watching agents get real teeth and physical AI get a shared backbone. That's one story.

news.headline: Claude Opus 5 builds a complete game from scratch in one shot
news.body: Someone gave Claude Opus 5 a single prompt asking it to build a first-person shooter at Call of Duty quality. It produced a 55,000-line game in one shot, using Three.js in the browser. No art assets, no sound files, no external libraries. Everything, textures, physics, audio, was generated from code at load time. Here is what the AI built from scratch: Honest caveat: critics scored it 5 out of 10 against real Call of Duty frames. It looks procedural up close. But the repo is public, the prompt is included, and you can run it yourself with npm install and npm run dev. What this opens up is the ability to prototype entire interactive experiences from a description alone.
bullets: 11 full subsystems : rendering, physics, AI soldiers, weapons, audio, UI, and more
A physics engine written from zero, no library, with ragdoll deaths and bullet penetration
Web Audio synthesis, meaning all sounds are computed, not loaded from files
A 120x120m playable map with enterable buildings and hundreds of props

news.headline: OpenAI's ChatGPT Work agent can now log into password-protected websites
news.body: The ChatGPT Work agent just got a lot more useful. It can now access websites that require a login, which was the biggest wall stopping it from doing real work on your behalf. Here is how it works. When the agent hits a login page, it pauses and hands control to you. You log in manually, then pass control back. From that point, the agent picks up exactly where it left off and keeps going on its own. The best part: your login persists across sessions , so you only do this once per site. Cookies stick around just like in a normal browser. On the security side, when you take over the browser to type your password, the agent sees nothing . No screenshots are captured, no credentials are stored. This opens up real end-to-end automation for any site behind a login wall.
bullets: You can now automate tasks on tools like Jira, Notion, or internal dashboards
Clear saved logins anytime in ChatGPT data settings
Avoid vague prompts like "handle everything" to stay in control

news.headline: Open-source AI companion runs locally, plays games and chats with 30+ LLM backends
news.body: You know Neuro-sama , the AI that streams games and chats with thousands of fans live? She's closed source, so when the stream ends, she's gone. Meet Airi , the open-source version you actually own and run yourself. Airi is a fully autonomous AI companion with an animated avatar. It talks to you in real time, remembers past conversations, and yes, it actually plays games with you. Tell it to build a cabin in Minecraft and it plans the path, gathers resources, and builds it. Here's what you get out of the box: It runs on Web, Desktop, and Mobile. No cloud required. Swap the AI brain anytime, from Claude to a local Ollama model. It's free, MIT licensed, and already has 17.5k stars on GitHub.
bullets: Real-time voice chat with sub-500ms response time
Animated Live2D or 3D avatar with blinking and emotion expressions
30+ LLM providers supported, swap models with one config change
